description: Operator seeds for slot tracing (scripts/trace-slots.ts). Seeds are rough routes read from gridded views of each image; on bare-sheet curves they were replaced by measured white-run centres (docs/tracks.md); they fix slot identity and direction only. Centrelines, widths and ends are measured by the tracer. 'start' is the end nearer -x (image left). 'occluded' lists overhead ends hidden under the figure standing on the slot, from visual inspection. 'occluded_bare' lists bare-sheet ends that cannot be seen because the slot runs inside a white printed area. 'exclude_from_homography' removes a slot from the bare->overhead fit, with the recorded reason.

path.W-LD.identity: Upper long slot in the W half (image y ~2230), ending in a downward curve near the centre line. A white/blue Finland (team W) figure stands at its curved end; the upper side (+y) is W's left.

path.W-RD.identity: Lower straight slot in the W half (image y ~3300). A Finland figure stands at its right end; the lower side (-y) is W's right.

occluded.middle: Finland figure standing over the slot near its right end (the end itself is visible just beyond the figure)

path.W-C.identity: Lower diagonal centre slot, crossing the grey centre disc into the E half. A Finland figure stands at its right end.

occluded.middle: puck lying on the slot near (3333, 2857); black printed logo box touching the slot inside the grey centre disc

occluded_bare.start: white printed band of the centre disc

path.E-LD.identity: Lower long slot in the E half (image y ~3360), starting with a curve just left of the centre line. A yellow Sweden (team E) figure stands at its curved left end; the lower side (-y) is E's left (E attacks -x).

path.E-RD.identity: Upper straight slot in the E half (image y ~2280). A Sweden figure stands at its left end; the upper side (+y) is E's right.

path.E-C.identity: Upper diagonal centre slot, from the W half into the grey centre disc. A Sweden figure stands at its left end.

occluded.middle: black printed logo box touching the slot inside the grey centre disc

occluded_bare.end: white printed band of the centre disc

path.E-RW.identity: Upper winger slot from the W corner (curving at the top-left) along the top to the E blue line region. A yellow Sweden (team E) figure stands at its curved left end; the upper side (+y) is E's right.

path.W-LW.identity: Upper winger slot from the centre region along the top, around the top-right corner and down behind the E goal. The Finland (team W) figure no. 26 stands on its lower end behind the E goal; the upper side (+y) is W's left.

path.E-LW.identity: Lower winger slot from behind the W goal (vertical along the W end), around the bottom-left corner and along the bottom to the W blue line. The Sweden figure no. 92 stands beside its top end and its stick crosses the slot; the lower side (-y) is E's left.

occluded.middle: stick of the Sweden figure crossing the slot near (705, 2680); light patches on the corner curve

path.W-RW.identity: Lower winger slot from the centre region along the bottom, curving up into the bottom-right corner. A Finland (team W) figure stands at its curved right end; the lower side (-y) is W's right.

path.W-G.identity: Short vertical goalie slot in the W crease, in front of goal.W. The Finland (team W) goalie stands over its lower part (pads beside the slot). The slot runs about 3 deg off the image vertical (measured dark-pixel centres). Seeds cover only the fully visible part (y <= 2762): below it the goalie's pad hides half the slot (measured dark-pixel widths).
path.W-G.exclude_from_homography: Measured 2026-09-30: after the fit, the mapped bare goalie slot lies +7.5 px (toward the rink centre) along x from the overhead slot, symmetric in both goals, while neighbouring slots agree within 1-4 px. Cause unresolved (older sheet version, or slot-wall visibility). Excluded from the fit so this systematic difference does not bias it; residuals still reported.

path.E-G.identity: Short vertical goalie slot in the E crease, in front of goal.E. The Sweden (team E) goalie stands over its upper part. The slot runs about 3 deg off the image vertical (measured dark-pixel centres). Seeds cover only the fully visible part (y >= 2855): above it the goalie's pad hides half the slot (measured dark-pixel widths).
path.E-G.exclude_from_homography: Measured 2026-09-30: after the fit, the mapped bare goalie slot lies -7.1 px (toward the rink centre) along x from the overhead slot, symmetric in both goals, while neighbouring slots agree within 1-4 px. Cause unresolved (older sheet version, or slot-wall visibility). Excluded from the fit so this systematic difference does not bias it; residuals still reported.
